banner.phase0: The foundation is live — tools are rolling out phase by phase.

hero.subtitle: Most tools run right in your browser — no uploads, no waiting.

steps.title: How it works
steps.subtitle: Three steps, three clicks — the same simple flow for every tool.
steps.s1desc: Pick files from your device, or simply drop them in.
steps.s2desc: Set your options with a live preview before running.
steps.s3desc: Save, share, or chain straight into the next tool.

categories.title: Explore the toolbox
categories.subtitle: {count} tools across {categories} categories — with an honest mode badge on every tool.
categories.phaseNote: Roadmap order: device-only tools first, server tools last.

why.title: Why DocoPDF?
why.subtitle: Honest, private, and built mobile-first for India.
why.privateDesc: Device-only tools never send your files anywhere. What's yours stays yours.
why.fastDesc: No upload wait — processing happens on your own device, even offline.
why.freeDesc: No signup, no watermarks, no hidden limits on device tools. Ever.

modes.title: Two honest modes
modes.subtitle: Every tool tells you exactly where your file goes — nothing hidden.
modes.deviceDesc: The whole job runs in your browser using Web Workers. Your file never touches the network.
modes.devicePoint1: Merge, split, compress, sign, edit and much more
modes.devicePoint2: Works offline once installed as an app
modes.devicePoint3: Zero upload time — great for batches
modes.serverDesc: Only for jobs a browser can't do well (like Office ↔ PDF). Files are deleted immediately after processing — never stored.
modes.serverPoint1: Deleted right after the job (15-minute fail-safe)
modes.serverPoint2: No file names or contents in any log
modes.serverPoint3: Clear limits: 10 free server tasks per day

tools.title: All tools
tools.subtitle: {count} tools across the toolbox — favorites and recent tools stay on this device.
tools.noResultsDesc: Try a different word, or tell us what you need — we build the most-requested tools first.
tools.searchHint: Search as you type — try “merge”, “jodein” or “password”.

request.title: Request a tool
request.description: Tell us what's missing. Requests are saved on this device until tool-request voting goes live.
request.descPlaceholder: A short description of what you need…

palette.title: Search tools
palette.description: Search the DocoPDF toolbox by name, tag or Hindi keyword.

consent.title: Your choice, your data
consent.body: DocoPDF works without analytics. Allow anonymous usage counts to help us improve? No file names, no file contents — ever.
consent.analyticsDesc: Aggregate tool usage counts only. Always off for file contents.
consent.essentialNote: Essential cookies (language, theme, favorites) are always on and stay on your device.

pro.title: Pro is coming
pro.body: Paid features arrive in a later phase. Device-only tools will always stay free — that's a promise.

footer.trust: Most tools run inside your browser. Your files stay on your device.
footer.phaseNote: DocoPDF is being built in phases — the design system is live, tools are next.

dropzone.limits: PDF up to {size} · up to {count} files
dropzone.errTooManyDesc: This tool accepts up to {count} files at once.
dropzone.errTooLargeDesc: The limit is {size} per file on this device.
dropzone.errNotPdfDesc: We checked the file's content — it isn't a valid PDF.
dropzone.warnLowSpaceDesc: Your browser storage is nearly full. Consider freeing some space.

tool.helpPrivacy: Everything happens on this device. The file is never uploaded, and working copies are deleted as soon as the tool finishes.
tool.how1: Select one or more PDF files — they stay on your device.
tool.how2: Set your options and check the preview before running.
tool.how3: Download the result, share it, or chain it into another tool.
tool.keepTabOpen: Tip: keep this tab open. You can keep using the site in another tab.
tool.errorGeneric: The tool hit an unexpected error. Please try again. {detail}
tool.errorInvalidPages: That page selection isn't valid. Use ranges like 1-3, 5.
tool.errorEncrypted: This PDF is password-protected. Unlock it first, then try again.
tool.errorCorrupt: This PDF couldn't be read — it may be damaged
tool.notFoundDesc: It's on the roadmap. Browse the toolbox meanwhile.
tool.summaryMinFiles: Add at least {count} files to continue
tool.splitWaitingDetect: Split inputs are still being detected — try again in a moment.
tool.splitNoBookmarks: This PDF has no bookmarks to split by.
tool.splitNoBlanks: No blank pages found — nothing to split at.
tool.splitNoParts: These split settings produce no files — adjust them and try again.

images.errorUnsupported: This image format can't be read here ({detail}). Convert it to JPG or PNG first.
images.errorDecode: Couldn't decode {detail} — the file may be damaged or unsupported on this browser.

tool.errorNoText: No selectable text found — this PDF is probably a scan. OCR is coming in a later phase.
tool.errorWatermarkMissing: Add the watermark text (or a logo) first.
tool.errorWatermarkChars: Built-in PDF fonts cover Latin letters and digits only — Hindi watermark text needs a custom font, planned for a later phase.
tool.errorWatermarkLogo: The logo image could not be read. Try a PNG or JPG.
tool.errorWatermarkNoPages: No pages selected — check the pages option.

result.title: Your file is ready!
result.openPreviewLabel: Open file preview in a new tab
result.privacyLine: This file is only on your device — nothing was uploaded.

recent.title: Recent files
recent.note: Metadata and thumbnails only, on this device — file contents are never kept.
recent.reselectToast: File contents aren't stored (privacy) — please select the file again.

smartDrop.selectLabel: Drop a PDF here — or select a file
smartDrop.whatNext: What would you like to do?
smartDrop.officeNote: Office conversions use server processing and arrive in a later phase.

merge.emptyHint: Add files to set pages and order.
merge.rangeHint: Leave empty to include the whole file. Ranges like 1-3, 5.
merge.blankBetweenHint: Separates each file's pages with one empty page.
merge.flattenHint: Best effort: locks filled values into the page. Some complex forms may keep their fields.

split.emptyHint: Add a PDF to set up the split.
split.rangeHint: List ranges like 1-5, 8, 10-end — “end” means the last page.
split.rangePrompt: Enter ranges like 1-5, 8, 10-end to see the preview.
split.overlapWarning: Ranges overlap — those pages will appear in more than one file.
split.oneFilePerRangeHint: Off: all ranges are combined into one new PDF.
split.everyNHint: Cuts the document into equal parts of this many pages.
split.bookmarksList: each part starts where a bookmark points.
split.sizeHint: Pages are grouped so each part stays under this size.
split.visualHint: Tap the scissors between two pages to set a cut point there.
split.oddEvenHint: Creates two files: odd-numbered pages and even-numbered pages.
split.blanksNone: No blank pages found in this PDF.
split.blanksFound: {count} blank pages found — they act as separators and are removed.
split.blanksChipLabel: Blank pages that will be removed
split.noParts: Nothing to output with these settings.

grid.allDeleted: Every page is deleted — undo to bring them back.
grid.insertBlankLabel: Insert a blank page after the selection
grid.howSelect: Click to select · Shift+click for a range · Ctrl+click to add
grid.howDrag: Drag the handle on a page to reorder it.
grid.virtualHint: Large document — drag is off, use the move buttons instead.
grid.ctaAllRemoved: All pages are deleted — undo to continue
grid.summaryWaiting: Add a PDF to see its pages here.

igrid.hint: Drag cards to reorder · rotate or remove per image · add more below

igrid.ctaNoImages: Add at least one image first
